content.short: Credit is an undercollateralized peer-to-pool lending protocol on World Chain.
content.description: Credit is an undercollateralized lending protocol on World Chain, built by Divine Research, where lenders supply USDC to a pool that funds loans. Undercollateralized lending depends on knowing something about the borrower, and World Chain's verified-human identity layer is what makes that plausible there. Most DeFi lending requires borrowers to post more collateral than they borrow, which limits it to people who already have capital.
